notes: The ground this area owns: the campus west of the railway north of the Ice Arena, from the TV Tower lot at Clove Road's south end to the junction north of Lot 61 (Clove Road, Village Road, Hawk Crossings, Sinatra Hall, The Village, and Lots 41, 27, 29, 28, 47, 48, 45, 46 and 61). Clove Road is unnamed in OpenStreetMap on this stretch; it is the road running from (-295, 538) north-north-east to the junction at (-45, 1360) and east to the rail crossing. South: Clove Road cut square at y 535..541 (its run there heads 74 deg); west of it the edge runs just south of Lot 41's south end (y 532..540). East of the road the edge goes north along the road's east sidewalk, 1.5 to 3 m outside the white TV Tower building (OSM 233913195, university, x -283..-262, y 537..563) and the red-roofed building beside it, and 2 m past the north fence of their fenced yard (y 597), then east along y 599.5 to the railway. The two buildings, the lattice tower and the fenced yard are left out (UNVERIFIED: the brief takes the red-roofed building for an off-campus business; south of y 535 the ground is houses, the TV Tower group and woods, not campus ground). East (measured from the published tiles' triangles, everything kept out by a buffer and then the outline simplified with checked clearances: at least 3.4 m from the rail ballast, at least 1 m from any other published mesh): 3.5 m west of the ballast's west edge from y 599 to 611; round the west side of Lot 28S (KQ asphalt) and the greenhouse pad 1.5 to 2 m out; into the walk gap between the greenhouse pad and the Children's Center yard; up the west side of the Ben Samuels Children's Center, its porch and drop-off apron and its play-yard fence 1.3 to 2 m out (the parking strip between Clove Road and the Center is inside); along the yard's north fence 2 m out; east to 3.7 m west of the ballast (Lot 28 is inside: the published model has only terrain there); north along the ballast to the NJ Transit deck; 2 m outside the deck's south, west and north walls; round the west and north side of the station drop-off loop's published asphalt (JS3: its south and east arcs and the JR2 island walk stay published; the loop island and its west arc are inside); north of the JW feather and east to 3 m west of the west track's ballast, which runs west of the station platform; then up that track to the end of the published ballast (y 1232) and straight on at x -12 (7 m or more west of the single track's ballast in the ortho) to Clove Road's rail crossing. North: Clove Road cut square at x -12 just west of the rail crossing (it heads about 15 deg there); west along y 1371 1 m south of the Great Notch Substation's south fence (OSM 1168865774, left out), north at x -46 (3 m west of the substation) to y 1378, then west along y 1378 just south of Lot 60N (OSM, y 1379 and beyond, left out), cutting the north spur road and the road to Lot 60N square, to (-138, 1378); then south-west across the drive towards the Vehicle Maintenance yard (left out) to the north-west corner of Lot 61 and down Lot 61's west curb to (-154, 1305). The large unnamed lot west of Lot 61 (x -240..-160, y 1300..1385) and the bus lot north of it are left out: they belong with Lot 60 and the maintenance yard north of the evidence. West: 3 to 5 m north and west of Lot 45's edge (OSM) to its west end at x -383; the wood edge west of the stormwater basin (x -390..-372) and Lot 48 (8 m out); the wood west of Sinatra Hall (12 m out, x -222..-228); then one straight run 10 to 20 m west of the Hawk Crossings buildings (Buteo, Accipiter, Falco) and 5 m west of Lot 41 down to y 532. All of it is inside the evidence (x -400..20). Inside: Clove Road from y 535 to the rail crossing and its junction north of Lot 61; Village Road; the north drive of Lot 61; the station drop-off loop island and west arc; Lot 41 (-344..-306, 540..608); Lot 27 (-267..-224, 603..715); Lot 29 (-295..-218, 649..851); the Children's Center parking strip (-190..-170, 780..870); Lot 28 (-152..-81, 868..936); Lot 47 (-210..-158, 998..1043); Lot 48 (-294..-219, 1100..1161); Lot 45 (-378..-162, 1194..1297); Lot 46 (-136..-67, 1265..1320); Lot 61 with its three solar canopies (-159..-64, 1308..1373); the station-side parking (OSM 287712281, -48..-28, 1116..1184); the stormwater basin (-364..-302, 1170..1216); Hawk Crossings Falco (-329..-293, 619..706), Accipiter (-297..-267, 714..785) and Buteo (-271..-238, 790..871); Francis A. Sinatra Hall (-216..-184, 918..994); Williams Hall (-209..-141, 1056..1123); Fenwick Hall (-243..-174, 1088..1158); Count Basie Hall (-127..-72, 1162..1233); Paul Hall (-170..-114, 1182..1254); the Abbott and Costello Center (-154..-126, 1130..1158); a small building at (-123..-101, 1113..1131) and a kiosk at (-52..-48, 1151..1158) (OSM, unnamed). Left out, published: the railway, Lot 28S, the greenhouse, the Ben Samuels Children's Center and its yards, the NJ Transit deck, the station platform, stairs and bridge, the loop's JS3 asphalt and island walk, the Ice Arena and its lots. Positions of things inside are from OpenStreetMap, UNVERIFIED to the metre.

supersede.notes: Patterns match 'mesh name material name' in the other sources' tiles. clip: their ground inside the footprint (triangle area inside the outline, m2, from the tiles dump: Context_skirt_3DEP_ortho_4km 140073, M3a_north_LiDAR_DTM_1m_ext (North_ground_ortho2020) 9699, North_terrain_LiDAR_1m (North_ground_ortho2020) 9699; MH_ground_ortho2020 and BD_farfield_3DEP 0, kept so that any of their ground under the outline goes too). drop: far_houses (far_houses_microsoft blocks, 215 m2, stand on Lot 61 where its solar canopies are). No building, platform, fence or paving of the published model lies inside: the outline keeps 3.4 m or more from the ballast and 1 m or more from every other published mesh. About five published trees stand inside (crowns near (-85, 910) east of Lot 28, (-215, 610) and (-219, 647)); they are not ground and are left alone.
